quality.name: Background quality
quality.hint: High is cleaner around your hair and takes a little more of your graphics card. It needs graphics acceleration in your browser; without it, Standard is used.

blurStrength.name: Blur strength
blurStrength.hint: How strongly the background is blurred.

controls.addressHint: The address of an image on the web (https://…). Its server must allow other sites to use it.
